title: Benchmarking Generative AI and Physics-Based Molecular Simulation for Sampling Conformational Heterogeneity in T4 Lysozyme.
journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
one_liner_zh: 该文以T4溶菌酶为基准，系统比较生成式AI与物理模拟在构象采样中的表现，发现AI方法仅采样单一状态而AI加速模拟结合物理方法可恢复全部构象态，直接聚焦蛋白质构象异质性采样这一核心计算问题，方法对比兼具AI与物理模拟，对本课题具有重要参考价值。
abstract: Wild-type T4 lysozyme (T4L) is used as a benchmark to evaluate conformational sampling across generative AI, AI-accelerated molecular simulation (AMS), and physics-based enhanced molecular dynamics (EMD). A four-state model horizontal line exposed/open, exposed/closed, buried/open, and buried/closed; is defined using physically meaningful collective variables. Generative AI methods (AF-cluster, MSA subsampling of AlphaFold2, ConforFold, AlphaFlow, ESMFlow, ConfRover, BioEmu) largely sample only the exposed/open state. In contrast, AMS integrates generative ensembles with physics-based molecular simulations, recovering all states and reproducing equilibrium populations similar to EMD and experimental smFRET signatures.
abstract_zh: 野生型T4溶菌酶（T4L）被用作基准，以评估生成式人工智能、人工智能加速分子模拟（AMS）及基于物理的增强分子动力学（EMD）中的构象采样。一个四态模型——暴露/开放、暴露/闭合、埋藏/开放、埋藏/闭合——通过物理上有意义的集体变量进行定义。生成式人工智能方法（AF-cluster、AlphaFold2的MSA子采样、ConforFold、AlphaFlow、ESMFlow、ConfRover、BioEmu）主要仅采样暴露/开放状态。相比之下，AMS将生成式集成与基于物理的分子模拟相结合，恢复所有状态，并重现与EMD及实验smFRET特征相似的平衡群体。
